name: metric
delta
sql:
SELECT sum("value") AS value
FROM (SELECT * EXCLUDE (value, previous_value), CASE WHEN previous_value IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE value - previous_value END AS value FROM (SELECT *, lag(value) OVER (PARTITION BY name, labels ORDER BY ts) AS previous_value FROM {{metrics}} WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end AND (((name = $cf0)))))
WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end

name: custom
trace
session
sql:
SELECT count(*) AS value
FROM (SELECT project_key, session_id, min(ts) AS ts, arg_max(user_agent, ts) AS user_agent, arg_max(domain, ts) AS domain FROM {{sessions}} WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end GROUP BY project_key, session_id)
WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end AND ((domain = $cf0))
